SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    battlevel,
    battcapmah,
    battlifeh,
    chgtimemin,
    usbpwrline,
    pwridlemw,
    pwractmw
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    battlifeh,
    chgtimemin,
    battcapmah,
    battlifeh * 60.0 / chgtimemin as life_charge_ratio,
    battcapmah::numeric / (pwractmw + 1) as cap_power_ratio,
    battlifeh / (chgtimemin / 60.0) as hourly_efficiency
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
LIMIT 20;

-- Try different possible BER formulas
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    battlevel,
    battcapmah,
    battlifeh,
    chgtimemin,
    -- Maybe BER = battlifeh / (chgtimemin/60) / some_factor
    -- Or BER = battcapmah * battlifeh / (chgtimemin * pwractmw)
    (battcapmah::numeric * battlifeh) / (chgtimemin * (pwractmw + 1)) as ber_formula1,
    -- Maybe BER involves battlevel
    (battlevel::numeric * battlifeh) / chgtimemin as ber_formula2,
    -- Maybe BER = battlifeh * battlevel / battcapmah
    (battlifeh * battlevel::numeric) / battcapmah as ber_formula3,
    -- Maybe BER = battlifeh / (chgtimemin / battlevel)
    (battlifeh * battlevel::numeric) / chgtimemin as ber_formula4
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_formula1 DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Check usbpwrline values and see if they relate to the 7.5 threshold
SELECT DISTINCT usbpwrline FROM testsessions ORDER BY usbpwrline;

-- Try BER = battlifeh * 100 / chgtimemin (battery life as % of charge time)
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    battlevel,
    battcapmah,
    battlifeh,
    chgtimemin,
    round((battlifeh * 100.0 / chgtimemin)::numeric, 2) as ber_pct,
    round((battlifeh::numeric / chgtimemin * 100), 2) as ber_pct2
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_pct DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Try BER = battlifeh / chgtimemin * some_factor to get values around 7.5
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    round((battlifeh / chgtimemin)::numeric, 4) as ber_raw,
    round((battlifeh / chgtimemin * 10)::numeric, 2) as ber_x10,
    round((battlifeh::numeric / chgtimemin * 60)::numeric, 2) as ber_per_hr
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_raw DESC
LIMIT 30;

-- Maybe BER = battlifeh / (chgtimemin/60) / battlevel * some_factor
-- Or perhaps it involves power consumption
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    round((battlifeh::numeric / (chgtimemin / 60.0) / battlevel * 10)::numeric, 2) as ber_test1,
    -- BER = battcapmah / (pwractmw + pwridlemw) * battlifeh / chgtimemin
    round(((battcapmah::numeric / (pwractmw + pwridlemw)) * battlifeh / chgtimemin)::numeric, 2) as ber_test2,
    -- BER = battlifeh / (chgtimemin / battlevel / 10)
    round((battlifeh * battlevel::numeric / chgtimemin / 10)::numeric, 2) as ber_test3
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_test3 DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Let me look at what makes sense: BER might be battlifeh divided by charge time in hours, scaled somehow
-- Or perhaps it's related to power efficiency: energy out / energy in
-- Energy stored = battcapmah * battlevel/100 / 1000 * voltage (assume 3.7V)
-- Energy in = pwractmw * chgtimemin/60 / 1000
-- Let me try: BER = (battcapmah * battlifeh) / (chgtimemin * 1000)
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    round((battcapmah::numeric * battlifeh / (chgtimemin * 1000))::numeric, 2) as ber_e1,
    -- Maybe simpler: battlifeh / (chgtimemin / battlevel / 10)
    round((battlifeh * battlevel::numeric / chgtimemin)::numeric, 2) as ber_e2,
    -- Or: battlifeh / chgtimemin * battlevel / 10
    round((battlifeh::numeric / chgtimemin * battlevel / 10)::numeric, 2) as ber_e3
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_e2 DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Maybe BER involves extracting numeric value from usbpwrline
-- Let's look at devices with simple W values vs USB-PD values
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    usbpwrline,
    battlifeh,
    chgtimemin,
    battcapmah,
    battlevel,
    -- Try: battlifeh / (chgtimemin/60) / battcapmah * 1000
    round((battlifeh::numeric / (chgtimemin/60.0) / battcapmah * 1000)::numeric, 2) as ber_cap,
    -- Or: battlifeh / chgtimemin * battcapmah / 1000
    round((battlifeh::numeric / chgtimemin * battcapmah / 1000)::numeric, 2) as ber_cap2
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0
ORDER BY ber_cap DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Let me try: BER = (battlifeh * battcapmah) / (chgtimemin * pwractmw) 
-- This would be like energy out / power in
SELECT 
    sessionregistry,
    makername,
    modnum,
    round(((battlifeh * battcapmah::numeric) / (chgtimemin * (pwractmw + 1)))::numeric, 2) as ber_e4
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
WHERE battlevel > 0 AND chgtimemin > 0 AND pwractmw > 0
ORDER BY ber_e4 DESC
LIMIT 20;
